name: Normal antenatal pathway (FOGSI/WHO-aligned)
note: One normal, low-risk antenatal pathway. Windows are gestational-age weeks. Thresholds and danger signs are set by the team's doctor; the rules engine - never an LLM - compares values against them.

hb.label: Haemoglobin
hb.message: Haemoglobin is below 11 g/dL (anaemia in pregnancy).

bp_sys.label: Systolic BP
bp_sys.message: Systolic blood pressure is 140 or above.

bp_dia.label: Diastolic BP
bp_dia.message: Diastolic blood pressure is 90 or above.

glucose_fasting.label: Fasting glucose
glucose_fasting.message: Fasting glucose is 92 mg/dL or above (IADPSG).

glucose_ogtt_1h.label: OGTT 1-hour
glucose_ogtt_1h.message: OGTT 1-hour glucose is 180 mg/dL or above (IADPSG).

glucose_ogtt_2h.label: OGTT 2-hour
glucose_ogtt_2h.message: OGTT 2-hour glucose is 153 mg/dL or above (IADPSG).

danger_signs: Swelling of face and hands with headache

milestones.title: First consultation (booking visit)
milestones.prep_notes: Bring any previous prescriptions and reports. Note the first day of your last period.

milestones.title: Baseline blood tests
milestones.prep_notes: No fasting needed except if a fasting glucose is planned.

milestones.title: NT scan (first trimester ultrasound)
milestones.prep_notes: Done between 11 and 13+6 weeks. A moderately full bladder helps.

milestones.title: Second-trimester review
milestones.prep_notes: Weight, blood pressure and growth check. List any new symptoms.

milestones.title: Anomaly scan (TIFFA)
milestones.prep_notes: Detailed scan of the baby's organs, usually 18-22 weeks. No fasting needed.

milestones.title: Glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
milestones.prep_notes: Come fasting (8-10 hours, water allowed). The test takes about 2 hours.

milestones.title: Tdap/TT vaccination
milestones.prep_notes: Protects the baby from whooping cough and tetanus.

milestones.title: Third-trimester review
milestones.prep_notes: Repeat haemoglobin. Mention any swelling, headache or reduced movements.

milestones.title: Growth scan
milestones.prep_notes: Checks the baby's growth and fluid levels.

milestones.title: Antenatal review (34 weeks)
milestones.prep_notes: Track baby movements daily from now on.

milestones.title: Antenatal review (36 weeks)
milestones.prep_notes: Discuss birth plan and warning signs.

milestones.title: Antenatal review (38 weeks)
milestones.prep_notes: Know when to go to the hospital: regular pains, leaking, bleeding.

milestones.title: Birth plan review
milestones.prep_notes: Confirm hospital, transport, and who accompanies you.
